dedupe_keys.name: ethiopia palmer drought severity index pdsi

description: Ethiopia - Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI) is a hazard data set listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by 3iS. This dataset provides Palmer Drought Severity Index (PDSI) values for Ethiopia from 2020 to 2024, offering insights into drought conditions across the country. The PDSI is a widely used drought index that measures deviations in soil moisture conditions from the long-term average, helping to identify both drought and wet conditions. Coverage: Ethiopia. The portal files it under the publisher 3iS. Its tags are drought, environment. It offers 4 resource(s) in KML, PDF, PNG, XLSX. The portal shows 2025-04-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY (version not stated). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
